# AVIF decoder fixtures

Generated by `python -I testdata/avif/make_fixtures.py` with FFmpeg/libaom and
Pillow's libavif support. The synthetic images contain no user data.

Except for the grid (128×128), images are 64×64. Sample quadrant centers at
¼ and ¾ of each dimension. Normal order is red / green / blue / white, from
top left to bottom right. RGB tolerance is ±16 (8-bit 4:2:0 typically yields
(255,1,3), (0,255,11), (1,0,243), (255,255,255)). Alpha is exact.

| File | Purpose / expected display |
| --- | --- |
| `quadrant_8bit_420.avif` | 8-bit 4:2:0, BT.709 limited range; normal quadrants |
| `quadrant_10bit_420.avif` | 10-bit 4:2:0 → RGBA8; normal quadrants |
| `quadrant_12bit_444.avif` | 12-bit 4:4:4 → RGBA8; normal quadrants |
| `quadrant_8bit_422.avif` | 8-bit 4:2:2; normal quadrants |
| `quadrant_full_range_444.avif` | 8-bit 4:4:4, BT.601 full range; normal quadrants |
| `quadrant_alpha_444.avif` | Straight alpha: left half 0, right half 255; RGB quadrants retained |
| `quadrant_grid_2x2.avif` | Four solid 64×64 tiles assembled into 128×128; normal quadrants |
| `quadrant_irot90cw.avif` | Clockwise 90°: blue / red / white / green |
| `quadrant_imir_horizontal.avif` | Horizontal mirror: green / red / white / blue |
| `animated_first_quadrant.avif` | First frame quadrants, second frame black; return first only |
| `gray_128.avif` | Monochrome, RGB 128 (±1), alpha 255 |
| `truncated.avif` | First half of grid file; typed parse/decode failure |
| `not_avif.avif` | PNG signature followed by zeros; typed parse failure |

Tests compare path and byte decoding for every fixture, exercise mixed-case
extension dispatch, native failure → WIC → Susie order with fake backends,
preallocation limits, ZIP entry decoding and the thumbnail chain. Additional
clap/rotation combinations are built from the fixture's BMFF properties in tests.
